name: MTR-Bench

Composite Audio Evaluation Dataset (Anonymous Submission)
	


	
		
		Dataset Description
	

This dataset is constructed to evaluate multi-modal audio models across four critical dimensions: Complex Scenarios, Instruction Following, Safety Compliance, and Semantic Understanding. 
The dataset is designed for academic research and is currently anonymized for peer review (ACL).
